## Case 1: ultrametric tree

```{r}
library(ContPhylo)
library(ape)
set.seed(0)
p=rcoal(10)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
r=phylo2contphylo(p,type=1)
plot(r)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
p=contphylo2phylo(r)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

## Case 2: rooted tree

```{r}
library(ContPhylo)
library(ape)
set.seed(0)
p=rtree(10)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
r=phylo2contphylo(p)
plot(r)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
p=contphylo2phylo(r)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```


## Case 3: unrooted tree

```{r}
library(ContPhylo)
library(ape)
set.seed(0)
p=rtree(10,rooted = F)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
r=phylo2contphylo(p,type=3)
plot(r)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```

```{r}
p=contphylo2phylo(r)
plot(p)
axisPhylo(backward = F)
```
